Owns the TypeScript frontend for iZone, OneStore, Apple Zone, Mantiqa, and Strap Iraq (15,000+ monthly users). React Router (Remix), server-side loaders, Tailwind CSS, English/Arabic/Kurdish RTL, Laravel API, Mapbox checkout, First Iraqi Bank QR payments. Catalogue LCP 3.8s → 1.4s.
